content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I prioritize building strong relationships with my customers by providing them the best-personalized service to help them achieve their short-term and long-term financial goals. 

I enjoy facilitating the education and development of staff members so they are better equipped to help our customers achieve their financial goals.

A Little About Me

I joined the Nebula Trust team in 2014 as Assistant Branch Manager of the Bank’s multiple citiesbranch and was later promoted to Branch Manager of Nebula Trust Bank’s Waterford location, and now I am responsible for the Norwich branch region. In this role, I lead my teams by facilitating the education and development of staff members so they are better equipped to help our members achieve their financial goals. 

During my time with Nebula Trust Bank, I have organized Small Business Expos, branch events, educational classes, and worked with my team to ensure the efficient and effective operation of the branch. I am also a Lending Officer, specializing in conventional mortgages, home equity loans, consumer loans, and small business loan products. (NMLS ID#944516)

I have a Bachelor of Science degree from Southern New Hampshire University in Business Administration and I am a 2019 graduate of the Global School of Finance and Management.

I am actively involved in the community, serving as a volunteer at various events throughout the year.

My family and I reside in Ledyard, CT.
